==Biography==
===2017 Season===
Pepper, then known as '''Y1HAN''', joined [[Royal Never Give Up]] in the middle of the [[LPL/2017 Season/Spring Season|2017 LPL Spring Season]] as an emergency substitute after the team's starting jungler [[Mlxg]] and two substitutes [[BayBay]] and [[Again]] all had medical emergencies during the same week. Despite the unexpected circumstances, Y1HAN performed well, and stayed on the team for the [[LPL/2017 Season/Summer Season|2017 LPL Summer Season]], seeing occasional playtime. However, Y1HAN was not fielded during either of the team's playoffs runs. Likewise, he accompanied the team to the [[2017_Season_World_Championship/Main_Event|2017 World Championship]], but did not play. At the end of the season, he left the team and joined [[FunPlus Phoenix]], a new LPL team. He also changed his name to '''Pepper'''.

== Trivia ==
* His ID '''Y1han''' (遗憾) means "Regret" in Chinese.
** Chinese fans sometimes joke about this when RNG official blog says "hope no regret in this tournament."
